summary: @ornikar/postcss-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` on the installer's machine. `math_init.js` is a ~728 KB single-line JavaScript payload with obfuscator.io fingerprints (hex-named variables, a large numeric string-array `n7gIxM`, and a rotation function `WV8StW` for string-array indexing), tagged `// @bun @bun-cjs` so it runs under Bun and bypasses Node-based tooling. The advertised purpose of the package is a PostCSS plugin configuration (README and index.js expose only `syntaxPlugins`, `themePlugin`, `customMediaPlugin`, `autoprefixerPlugin`); neither the README nor the library entry references Bun, `math_init.js`, or any binary download. The install-time execution path is undocumented and unrelated to the package's stated purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
